Title: Announcing enhancements to Azure Virtual WAN

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual WAN brings together our Azure connectivity services into a single operational interface in partnership with major SDWAN partners. Azure Virtual WAN enables a global transit network architecture by providing ubiquitous connectivity between globally distributed sets of spokes such as VNets, sites, applications, and users. Significant enhancements include the preview of hub-to-hub and any-to-any connectivity. Virtual WAN users can connect multiple hubs for full mesh connectivity to further simplify their network architecture. Additionally, ExpressRoute and Point to Site are now Generally Available with Virtual WAN.

Learn more
